rationale: This changes canonical development/product UX policy for packaging a new-conversation handoff as one one-click-copyable payload. The accompanying Control Center implementation uses the already linked Qt GUI stack and adds only an in-process clipboard operation and shared QML presentation component. It does not add or modify a runner, provider, model, package dependency, device driver, host service, daemon, port/socket, credential delivery, hardware mutation, HRB lease path, accelerator backend, Current Host proof recipe, execution authority, or promotion claim. Therefore no fresh physical Current Host requalification is required. Any later change that introduces a new host/runtime dependency or execution path requires a separate structural-impact assessment.
